description: Policy: engine version pins (engine_versions/<engine>/current.yaml) bump ONE engine per PR.
Each engine's regex-managed dep has its own packageRule with no shared groupName, so Renovate
opens a separate branch/PR per engine (its default for distinct packages: transformers, vllm,
tensorrt-llm). Do not add a shared groupName across engines. One engine per bump PR keeps the
PR reviewable and its absorb diff self-contained (evidence: #792's 23-file single-engine bump
Freeze (v0.8 development cycle): the per-engine rules below are currently held by the two
'enabled: false' freeze rules at the end of packageRules. The one-engine-per-PR policy above
still governs; it resumes as soon as the freeze rules are removed.

packageRules.description: Engine pin: transformers. Own PR, one engine per bump (see top-level policy).
Engine pin: vllm. Own PR, one engine per bump (see top-level policy).
Engine pin: tensorrt. Own PR, one engine per bump (see top-level policy).

Engine pins are frozen for the v0.8 development cycle: mined engine-knowledge artefacts and measurement baselines are tied to the pinned versions, so a mid-cycle engine bump would invalidate them. Covers the three regex-managed pins in engine_versions/<engine>/current.yaml (transformers, vllm, tensorrt-llm). Remove this rule when the freeze lifts. See #926.

Frozen alongside the engine pins for the v0.8 development cycle: pytorch/pytorch is the transformers engine image substrate, so bumping it moves the same measurement baseline the engine pins hold fixed. Tooling images (ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv) are deliberately not matched. Remove this rule when the freeze lifts. See #926.
